description: Search Just Eat UK restaurants by postcode or city, filter by cuisine, rating and open status, or fetch full menus from restaurant URLs or slugs.

cuisine.description: Only emit restaurants whose cuisines include this. Restaurants with no cuisine data always pass through.
cuisine.title: Cuisine filter

location.description: A UK postcode/outcode (e.g. `EC4M`, `SW1A 1AA`) or a major UK city name (e.g. `London`, `Manchester`). In menu mode, an optional location used to resolve numeric restaurant IDs.
location.title: Postcode or city (search mode)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to emit.
maxItems.title: Max items

minRating.description: Drop restaurants below this star rating (1-5). Restaurants with no rating data always pass through.
minRating.title: Minimum star rating

mode.description: Search restaurants near a location, or fetch full menus for specific restaurants.
mode.title: Mode

offset.description: Skip this many matching restaurants before emitting records. Combine with `maxItems` to page through the whole search result set.
offset.title: Start offset

openNowOnly.description: Only emit restaurants currently open for delivery.
openNowOnly.title: Open now for delivery only

proxyConfiguration.description: Just Eat's search API uses Cloudflare bot management. The actor automatically falls back to the included Apify AUTO proxy, so you don't need to configure anything. Supply a proxy only if you want to override that automatic choice.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration (optional)

restaurantIds.description: Restaurant menu URLs (https://www.just-eat.co.uk/restaurants-<slug>/menu), slugs, or numeric IDs. Numeric IDs also need `location` so they can be resolved to a slug.
restaurantIds.title: Restaurants (menu mode)

title: Just Eat Scraper Input
